ankleSetup: Ikhala amagulu galolere emberi. Sunya amano emberi, mani ugakokhe enyuma.
aquaticSetup: Mumatsi matiti, khenda oba khupa amakulu malayi n'obukhoonyi.
aquaticSub: Chenda nambe khupa amakulu mumatsi amatiti.
armLibraryCopy: Ebilagilo by'okhuyimusa omukhono nende okhufikha obuleeyi bw'ekifuba mu bulayi.
armSetup: Lekha omubiri kwa ingulu kubonekhe. Omwana ayimuse omukhono mufwe khu balloon.
balanceGameSub: Ikhala wima okhole tsiringi tsia balance.
balanceLibraryCopy: Ebilagilo by'okhwechesa balance mu bulayi n'obuyeti.
balanceSetup: Omubiri kwosi kubonekhe. Omwana ekhale wima, omulezi ali ampi.
ball-throwSetup: Ikhala khu mpira ya therapy n'obukhoonyi. Khupa mana ukambe mpira omwororo.
ballThrowSetup: Ikala khu mupira kwa therapy noyambibwa. Khupa kandi uambe omupira omuyoloyu.
beadsSetup: Khumba olukoye olukhongo, olunge shanga ingali ndala ndala.
bilatSetup: Khupirize akoleshe amakhono kombi hamwe — akhome amakhono, akuate, nambe akung'unye omupira.
breathingSetup: Konama oba ikhala bulayi. Ta omukhono khu nda, osa malayi.
breathingSub: Sa omwika omukali malayi, omukhono khu nda.
bridgeSetup: Kona khumugongo, amakulu gapindile. Yinula amakusiko malayi okhole daraja.
brushSetup: Kolesya ibrashi iyororo. Brasha amakhono n'amakulu malayi nga therapist alakila.
buttonsSetup: Kolesya dressing board ili n'amabuttoni amakhongo. Manyilila okhukonya n'okhufungula.
catchSetup: Kupa omupira omunolu mpola khu lwanda lwe kifuba. Omwana akhwola nende amakhono kombi.
clapSetup: Lola camera. Bila amakhono embeli we kifuba buli target ni yamurika.
crawlSetup: Yilula ahantu aharambi. Khonyelesia omwana akhabe alekhe echinjekha yiye yamakana.
crawlSub: Khambila khu makhono nende amakulu okhule khu mwisho.
cutSetup: Khumba safety scissors n'obukhoonyi. Kheba ulandule omukanda omukali omulunjifu.
dailyPlan: Omupango kwa therapy kwa buli lunaku
dailyPlanCopy: Mala session ndala y'emikhono, ndala y'amakulu, nende ndala ya balance n'obuyeti bw'omuleli.
drawSetup: Kolesia crayon khu karatasi, oba londelesia ebifwanani mu mweya nende ekisala.
dressSetup: Kolesia practice board yili nende amabutton amakhulu nende zips.
feedSetup: Ta obusanga bukhongo khu spoon. Omwana abutwale nakhukhonya tawe.
gaitLibraryCopy: Ebilagilo by'okhukhenda n'obuyeti nende okhwechesa amatambulo.
gaitSetup: Lomba injila inyindafu. Renga emberi malayi nende obuyeti.
gripSetup: Kolesia sponge omunolu oba stress ball. Nyunga, lindi sekondi 3, nukhule.
guidedSetup: Omwana akhonekhe khu kamera, mana ulandule ebilagilo by'omuleli.
half-kneelSetup: Ta likulu lilala hasi, nelindi liikhalile emberi. Ikhalile n'obukhoonyi.
halfKneelSetup: Ta likulu lilala hasi, okundi lukulu lube emberi luli pasi. Ikaza noyambibwa.
halfKneelSub: Ifukamire likulu lilala, okundi lukulu lube emberi.
handwritingSetup: Kolesya oluyala oba crayon okhulandula emikanda, ebiringa n'emisalaba.
headSetup: Yetanga omwana nga yikhale. Chendesa ekindu shimulikhavu malayi alondokane nasho nende emoni.
headSub: Londokana nende enondo ichenda nende emoni.
heel-raiseSetup: Khumba omukono. Nina khu bisinzili, ikhalile, mana wikhe malayi.
heelRaiseSetup: Uata khu rail. Yinukha khu zifwe z'amakulu, ikaza, nikho wikhe mpola.
heelRaiseSub: Yinukha khu zifwe z'amakulu, nikho wikhe hasi.
horseSetup: Ikhala okhukhaba bolster ingali oba peanut ball. Ikhalile bulayi niyenda malaayi.
kneelingSetup: Fukama khu mukeka omuyoloyu, amataka kali khu makulu. Wikaze noyambibwa.
langFallbackNote: UI ili mu Lungereza nikhwo amatapulula ka {lang} kategekhezibwa.
legLibraryCopy: Ebilagilo bya PT: yima khu khulu endafu, khola khu rail, nikwo ukube n'olundi. Omuleli asindikhe enyuma niyetaagwa.
legSetup: Yema khu kugulu kutali na mani, ukhumbe khu chuma. Tekha tsinondo nende kugulu kundi.
marchSetup: Khumba khu shifumbi shikhuyete. Yinula buli ikulu likhole obulayi nende ikhuba.
marchSub: Khamba khulondokana nende ikhuba lia ngoma.
midlineSetup: Ta target khu lubeka lundi lwe mubili. Omwana alusa okhubirira midline.
obstacleSetup: Ta ebintu bititi biyoloyu khu lunyiriri. Chama buli kilala noyambibwa.
oralSetup: Kolesya straw oba bubble wand. Vuvula malayi okhunyala amanyali k'omulomo.
oralSub: Vuvula amabubble oba nywa ni straw.
pinchSetup: Ta obusanga/pom-poms khu tray. Omwana anyola nende ekisala ekikhongo nende ekisala ekindi.
playdoughSetup: Kolesya play dough omwororo. Biringa, finya mana ukamule n'emikhono kyombi.
pnfSetup: Londokhanya omukhono hasi okhuchama omubiri, nikho yinula enze.
proneSetup: Khala khunda. Yekhomekhe khu mikhono cho hasi, yinule omutwe nende ekifuba.
proneSub: Yinula omutwe nende ekifuba noli nikhalile khunda.
puzzleSetup: Tola isifwanane, ukhingise muwundu eyanikhana nakho.
reachSetup: Tekha omusaani omunyoofu khu buleeyi bw'ekifuba. Omwana afikhe khukwo.
rollingSetup: Khala khu mukeka. Ikung'unye mpola okhurula khu mugongo okhuya khunda, nikho olukhe.
rollingSub: Ikung'unye okhurula khu mugongo okhuya khunda, kandi okalukhe.
safetyNote: Lekha niyaba nende obululu, esizunguzungu, oba obunafu obutari bwa bulijo.
sensorySetup: Tayarisia textures 3 (inalu, ikalafu, yili nende amabundu). Omwana akhumbe buli ndala.
sensorySub: Khumba ebinali, ebikalafu nende ebili nende amabundu.
shoulderSetup: Ikhala oba yema wima. Zungusha mabega emberi, enyulu, enyuma, nende hasi.
sidelyingSetup: Khala khu lubeka noyambibwa. Kolesha amakhono kombi okhuzana nende ekizanyo.
sidelyingSub: Zana nende amakhono kombi noli nikhalile khu lubeka.
simonSetup: Omulindi aloma ebichenje. Omwana akopa ni Simon aloma kwonyene.
sitstandSetup: Ikhala khu shifumbi shikali, amagulu gakhuye hasi. Yema malayi, mani wikhaleko kandi.
squatSetup: Tula amagulu nga obupanga bwa mabega, khumba khu chuma, pinda amakulu khakhali, mani wime.
step-upSetup: Kolesya isikha likeyi lili n'omukono. Nina n'okulu lulala, nelindi.
stepUpSetup: Kolesha litambwe lititi lili nende rail. Niina nende lukulu lulala, nikho okundi.
stepUpSub: Niina khu litambwe lititi, nikho wikhe hasi.
stretchSetup: Nyosha misuli mikali malayi nende obuyeti. Linda buli khunyosha esekondi 15–20.
trackSetup: Mutwe kukhale kutekhenye. Londelesia ekindu ekichenjanga mpola nende amoni kwonyene.
trunkSetup: Ikhala wima. Galusha omubiri kwa enyulu lubeka lwa lumosi nende lwa lulyo malayi.
wall-standSetup: Yemela omukongo n'ebisinzi bikhuya khu lusala. Ikhalile n'obukhoonyi.
wallStandSetup: Yimirira omugongo nende ebisinini by'amakulu nibikhoma khu lukomera. Ikaza noyambibwa.
